svg.title: Smart Warehouse Planner - landing page
svg.text: Smart Warehouse Planner reads the three files your warehouse
already exports (Locations, Inventory, Transactions), shows which
parts sit in the wrong place, and turns that into a move list
your colleagues can tick off, round by round.
Runs on a laptop, no accounts
The tool suggests; the planner decides.
Every recommendation names its rule and the numbers behind it:
“fast-moving: 61 picks in the period (24 or more)”.
Outlined: a dead-stock rider far right in a best location, a misfit you see at a glance.
From three exports to a printed list
Six steps, in this order, in every plan
